installed_attestation.scope: Read-only installed source, RECORD, interpreter, dependency and template-cache proof. No PA service state, credentials, Kernel, Store or workspace construction. Does not establish which modules/branches the listener executed; actual loaded owner/PID proof is separate.

named_module_paths.scope: Independent installed metadata subprocess with both private roots before imports, paired with supported actual loaded build/PID and native interpreter-path evidence. Not a claim that every installed module/branch executed in listener.

native_process.scope: Read-only native process and launch class; no environment values retained or policy/power/clock/service changes.

handoff_scope: The exact original continuation is running; effect remains pending until this turn settles. Do not replay/rearm or request another install/restart before positive completion and future exact gates.
native_diagnostics: All three complete fixed sections were exercised successfully through the dedicated authenticated MCP bridge. Expected provider environment sanitization remains; no user recovery or secret lookup is required. Original terminal question remains delivered/resolved and unmodified; no private response or additional consent published.

encoding.scope: Complete same-body decoder/content-length/schema checks. Dynamic GETs may differ; encoded BODY bytes exclude network framing and do not resolve decoded work.

fleet.scope: 96 field observations, not distinct incidents. 16 stale fields and probe_failed remain. No forced peer refresh or current remote loaded-build/log proof.

validation.scope: Durable order, retained cold content hashes, projection head and card checks; includes awaited validation observer persistence. Excluded from workload duration and captured counters.

private_late.scope: Five independent private synthetic stores, 100,000 compatibility rows and 500 already-canonical selected rows each. Timed region is the unchanged native migration method only; seeding and assertions are outside. Small-sample quantiles, not production migration throughput, fresh health timing, statistical speedup or whole-PA acceptance. Both roots are private before PA imports; no live Store mutation or fault injection.

private_reference_guard.scope: Five alternating pairs per private synthetic population, identical 1000 distinct references with repeated retained events. Complete fresh reference sets and every event retained; a subsequent publication is visible to both methods. No object files are seeded or health file checks skipped by product code; this benchmark measures referenced_hashes only, not full health/maintenance or production load. SQL VM work is a separate instrumented pass excluded from latency samples. Source/archive methods differ only in type validation; no schema, policy, warning or deadline change. Small samples do not prove statistical whole-path speedup or deployed acceptance.

installed_watch_read.scope: Thirty alternating pairs in one private synthetic store. Every status, realm and retired/terminal link is retained. Timers cover only the read, excluding comparison and observer persistence. Materialized JSON bytes are application copy work, not physical disk traffic. No provider closure, production workload, cadence/threshold change or whole-path speedup/acceptance is inferred. Both roots are private before PA imports.

installed_watch_matching.scope: Private sparse-link comparison: five alternating actual decision sweeps, sparse immutable metadata links, candidate index construction included. No durable close, SQL, provider, service policy or PA store mutation. Does not measure the whole lifecycle sweep or establish historical cause. Uses the actual imported candidate index and actual decision method. Source or installed module path/hash is retained; the caller must distinguish these scopes.

installed_lifecycle_contracts.scope: Existing lifecycle obligation, retirement, closure and reserved-capacity/concurrency contracts against exact installed modules, both roots private before every PA import. No live closure/provider workload or whole-path performance acceptance.

natural_maintenance.scope: One naturally completed live maintenance operation after exact activation, not manually triggered. Inclusive phase/SQL metrics overlap; never add them. Wall minus CPU remains unclassified off-CPU, not native busy/holder/GIL/disk proof. The status running flag describes the scheduler task, while timestamps mark this completed iteration.

benchmark.scope: Five alternating private sparse-link sweeps of the actual decision method. Index construction and lookup at the original guard point are included. Every decision and ordered OR occurrence matches, including both-key and equal distinct rows. No SQL, durable closure, real provider, service state or whole-sweep/historical cause/acceptance claim. Imported path/hash distinguishes source from installed code. Host load and normal GC remain uncontrolled.

source_dispatch_repair.implemented: Fresh copied-row index once per sweep on existing reserved worker; actual lookup at original guard point. Same limit=10000/deep=False read, OR link/order/equal-distinct/both-key semantics and raw-list fallback.
source_dispatch_repair.tests: 95 tests / 54 subtests pass after correcting a new terminal-order fixture to explicitly disable default recoverability. Initial 94-pass/one-failure stage and sandbox cache denial remain retained; no product guard changed.
source_dispatch_repair.limits: Sparse matching CPU evidence only. All dispatch enumeration/copying, shared-link worst cases, session/newer/lease/provider/workspace/queue amplification, durability/closure/concurrency and full-path acceptance remain open.
